'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Colombia earthquake]]
** A {{M|w|7.4}} earthquake strikes [[Chocó Department]], [[Colombia]], causing widespread and heavy damage, and leaving at least 288 people dead. [https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-08-10/at-least-25-people-dead-as-magnitude-74-earthquake-hits-colombia.html (''El Pais'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20e360lx0vo (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/earthquake-pacific-coast-shakes-colombian-capital-2026-08-10/ (Reuters)]
**The [[Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary, Manizales|Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary]] in [[Manizales]] is confirmed to be among the buildings damaged after one of the towers collapsed following the earthquake. [https://www.independent.co.uk/tv/news/colombia-earthquake-cathedral-collapse-video-b3030635.html (''The Independent'')] [https://thecitypaperbogota.com/news/powerful-7-4-earthquake-strikes-colombia-collapsing-buildings-across-western-cities/ (''The City Paper Bogota'')] [https://www.elcolombiano.com/amp/colombia/temblor-hoy-colombia-catedral-manizales-JL39761954 (''El Colombiano'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*[[Wildfires in 2026]]
**A recent [[wildfire]] at the [[Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park]] in [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]], is extinguished after {{cvt|550|ha|acres|abbr=on}} were burnt. However, new hotspots are also reported near [[Mount Bromo|the caldera]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/fire-near-indonesias-mount-bromo-extinguished-after-550-hectares-burnt-new-2026-08-10/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Philippines|Philippine]] [[Office of Civil Defense (Philippines)|civil defense office]] reports that at least 16 people were killed across [[Luzon]], including seven in [[Baguio]], by floods, landslides and [[Climate of the Philippines|weather]]-related accidents after nine days of heavy [[monsoon]] rain, while three others remain missing. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260810-days-of-heavy-rain-leave-at-least-13-dead-in-philippines (AFP via RFI)]

[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/10/drcs-ebola-outbreak-began-months-before-officially-declared-says-who (Al Jazeera)]
